name: Factual accuracy and groundedness
machine_reason: The submission accurately restates the supplied facts (alert 30-year-old, mild headache after missed lunch, no injury/weakness/fever/neck stiffness, no examination or test data), offers defensible hypotheses framed as possibilities rather than diagnoses, explicitly acknowledges that secondary causes cannot be excluded without examination, and avoids inventing findings. It also flags uncertainty about red flags and escalation, matching the highest anchor's requirement to acknowledge where evidence is uncertain.
